description: Population potentially exposed to road noise, 2016 and 2018 is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by U.S. Bureau of Transportation Statistics. This table shows the number and percent of people in the United States potentially exposed to different levels of noise from road sources. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 6 columns, among them Population exposed, 2018, Percent of total population, 2016, Percent of total population, 2018, Percent change 2016 to 2018, A-weighted 24-hour LAEQ (dBA), Population exposed, 2016. The portal shows 2020-06-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
